justifications.durability: tests/test_owed_plan_reviews_queue_held.py:127-214 fails if requests are not held, reviews are duplicated, review storage does not release them, or an answered finding leaves its section held.
justifications.evidence: focused-gate.log:1-8 records the required temporary-repository gate at revision 630b0fd7101e32ad1ebf15dc08d9904a85882f64 with 147 passed and EXIT=0, while negative-control-final.log:4-68 records the base refusal and failing test.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py:130 uses a capability-named helper and the changed source adds no plan-stage or version labels to code names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py:469 queues an implementation request when the review gate owes review, then composes the plan's owed reviews at lines 169-174.

justifications.scope_discipline: The final live write grants contain the changed reckon/ and tests/ paths and the section evidence fragment, including reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py:130.
